# Schedule 5 – Tax table for back payments, commissions, bonuses and similar payments

Work out the tax to withhold from payments of salary or wages that include a back payment, commission or bonus.

**Published** 17 June 2026

Print or Download

[**About this schedule**](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/schedule-5-tax-table-for-back-payments-commissions-bonuses-and-similar-payments/about-this-schedule)

Calculating amounts to withhold from back payments, commissions or bonuses and similar payments.

[**Tax file number (TFN) declarations**](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/schedule-5-tax-table-for-back-payments-commissions-bonuses-and-similar-payments/tax-file-number-declarations)

Withholding according to payees' TFN declarations.

[**Working out the withholding amount**](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/schedule-5-tax-table-for-back-payments-commissions-bonuses-and-similar-payments/working-out-the-withholding-amount)

Factors to consider when working out the withholding amount.

[**Back payment reporting**](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/schedule-5-tax-table-for-back-payments-commissions-bonuses-and-similar-payments/back-payment-reporting)

How to report back payments.

[**Withholding amounts examples**](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/schedule-5-tax-table-for-back-payments-commissions-bonuses-and-similar-payments/withholding-amounts-examples)

Examples of how to calculate the withholding amounts.

[**PAYG withholding publications**](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/schedule-5-tax-table-for-back-payments-commissions-bonuses-and-similar-payments/payg-withholding-publications)

Access to PAYG withholding tax tables and other PAYG withholding publications.
